title: ux/Dictate surfaces: the page that shows every voice and chat surface

owner_note.text: The page that shows every voice and chat surface is here: /framework/ux/Dictate/surfaces/. The 30 s first reply is the model's first token under load (8 to 17 s measured with 27 agents working); the pair spawn itself is instant.
